Driver startup/imports, frame construction and compilation excluded; auxiliary outer wall/CPU include startup and worker. Each invocation is a new process, not a resident runtime. Shared host, inherited affinity, no exclusive isolation. No general language, memory, safety or speed ranking.
scope: Separate parent-only successful fixed-session profiles, not untraced timing results. Strace excludes child executable work. Memcheck/Callgrind include driver startup, runtime, byte validation and adapter work, not isolated library costs. No cancellation path or complete mmap-backed storage accounting. Only checkout prefixes are normalized; raw log hashes retained. No general safety/performance ranking.
